summary: NEXUS Celestial Navigation V2 frontend testing complete. All specified flows verified working: page/HUD/console render with all data-testids, auto-settle to focused domain, drag+snap rotation with domain change, planet-tap opens flash+overlay, back button closes overlay, core-tap does not open overlay.

panelTimer useRef default undefined — TypeScript ok but consider ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined for clarity (already done).

All success.
